ne=struct.unpack_from('<I',b,0x3c)[0];st=ne+struct.unpack_from('<H',b,ne+0x22)[0];shift=struct.unpack_from('<H',b,ne+0x32)[0]

DIGITS='0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz'
def literal_digits(ax,dx,base,sign):
 out=[]
 if sign and base==10 and dx&32768:
  out.append('-');carry=int(ax!=0);ax=(-ax)&65535;dx=(-(dx+carry))&65535
 start=len(out)
 while True:
  high,rem=divmod(dx,base) if dx else (0,0)
  low,digit=divmod((rem<<16)|ax,base)
  ch=(digit+0x30)&255
  if ch>0x39:ch=(ch+0x27)&255
  out.append(chr(ch));ax=low;dx=high

 # Mirrors the unconditional first swap and pointer comparison at 6D24..6D30.
 left=start;right=len(out)
 while True:
  right-=1;out[left],out[right]=out[right],out[left];left+=1
  if not left+1<right:break
 return ''.join(out)+'\0'
def specification(value,base):

 while True:

wide=0

# String-op model has 16-bit offset wrap. Each MOVSW reads both bytes before writing.
def copy_literal(mem,dst,src,n):
 def op(size):
  nonlocal dst,src
  data=[mem[(src+i)&65535] for i in range(size)]
  for i,x in enumerate(data):mem[(dst+i)&65535]=x
  dst=(dst+size)&65535;src=(src+size)&65535
 if not n:return
 if dst&1:op(1);n-=1
 for _ in range(n>>1):op(2)
 if n&1:op(1)
def fill_literal(mem,dst,value,n):
 if not n:return
 if dst&1:mem[dst]=value;dst=(dst+1)&65535;n-=1
 for _ in range(n>>1):mem[dst]=value;mem[(dst+1)&65535]=value;dst=(dst+2)&65535
 if n&1:mem[dst]=value

  for src in [0,1,2,254,255,256,65534,65535]:

   e=bytearray(pattern);lead=int(bool(n and dst&1));sizes=[1]*lead+[2]*((n-lead)//2)+[1]*((n-lead)%2);offset=0
